note: Calibration of the rule engine against MCA-validated instance documents (golden-*.xml). Each entry names a Business Rules V1.2 requirement that an MCA-validated instance does not meet; the requirement stays visible but is reported as a WARNING instead of a blocking error. Only explicit workbook requirements contradicted by validated evidence are listed here; interpretation fixes are made in the engine and documented in AUDIT_REPORT.md. Since v1.2 an entry for a plain 'mandatory field' rule (since v1.5 also an 'assert' rule) may carry 'whenNilOrAbsent': the rule is a warning only for a year in which that element is absent, nil or 0, and stays blocking otherwise. Since v1.5.4 an entry with 'oneRow': true works the other way round: it adds an element the MCA validator requires beyond the workbook's mandatory line items, for at least one row (member) of the table per year — severity ERROR is blocking, WARNING is reported.
